subject: OBJECT-COMPUTER paragraph
notes: SR2 (cite.py --check 12.3.6.3 "Alphabet-name-2 shall reference an alphabet that defines a national collating sequence" -> OK §12.3.6.3 2)). ResolveProgramCollating resolves alphabet-name-2 (two-name IS form and FOR NATIONAL form) ONLY against NationalAlphabets and then requires HasCollatingSequence (Table 6: UTF-8/UTF-16 have no collating sequence). Probes: sr2a.cob FOR NATIONAL IS <alphanumeric alphabet> -> COBOL0898; sr2b.cob two-name form with undeclared name-2 -> COBOL0898; sr2c.cob name-2 = ALPHABET FOR NATIONAL IS UTF-16 -> COBOL0898; sr2d.cob FOR NATIONAL IS LOCALE alphabet (Table 6 LOCALE = Y) accepted and collates by locale (prints LOCALE-ORDER); at --std 85 the national surface is edition-gated (COBOL0900). Unlike the SR1 slot, the undeclared-name arm here is strict. The existing negative golden alphabet-utf8-collating is SR2-derived (the UTF-8 arm); the alphanumeric-alphabet and undeclared arms are verified by probe only.
